api_key.description: Skycloak API key (`sk_sc_{env}_..._...`). Prefer the `SKYCLOAK_API_KEY` env var. Minted in the dashboard.

api_version.description: Date-based API version, e.g. `2026-06-01.beta` (env `SKYCLOAK_API_VERSION`). Defaults to the version this provider release was built against.

endpoint.description: Public API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.skycloak.io` (env `SKYCLOAK_ENDPOINT`).

block.description: Manage your Skycloak managed-Keycloak environment as code.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID (unique within the realm). Immutable.

client_secret.description: Client secret (confidential clients). Returned on create; use a rotate operation to change it.

grant_types.description: OAuth grant types enabled for the client.

service_account_enabled.description: Whether a service account (client credentials) is enabled. Read-only.

block.description: An OIDC/SAML client (application) in a Skycloak realm.

client_id.description: Application client ID receiving the role. Immutable.

role_client_id.description: Client ID owning the role, for a client role. Omit for a realm role. Immutable.

block.description: Grants a role to an application's service account. One resource per (client, role) edge.

rotate_when.description: Arbitrary key/value map; changing any value forces a new secret to be generated.

block.description: Rotates an application's client secret. The secret is regenerated whenever this resource is created or `rotate_when` changes.

hostname.description: Hostname to protect; must be one of the cluster's verified custom domains. Immutable.

block.description: A hostname registered for CAPTCHA protection on a cluster. The number of registrable hostnames is capped per cluster; the API rejects additions beyond the cap.

login.description: Custom theme ID to activate for this client's login page. Omit to use the realm default.

block.description: Per-client login-theme override. Overrides the realm default for a single OIDC/SAML client.

auto_upgrade_enabled.description: Enable automatic patch upgrades, applied inside the cluster's maintenance window. Defaults to `false`.

location.description: Region (`us`, `ca`, `eu`, `au`). Immutable — changing it replaces the cluster.

type.description: Cluster type (`keycloak` or `tidecloak`). Immutable — changing it replaces the cluster.

block.description: A Skycloak managed Keycloak cluster.

extension_id.description: Catalog extension ID (see the `skycloak_extensions` data source). Immutable.

installed_version.description: Version currently running on the cluster.

parameters.description: Parameter values keyed by parameter `key`. Write-only (sensitive values are never read back). Changing this reinstalls the extension.

upgrade_available.description: Whether a newer version is available.

block.description: Installs a marketplace extension on a cluster. Installation is asynchronous; the `status` reflects provisioning progress. Changing `extension_id` or `parameters` reinstalls the extension.

days_of_week.description: Days of week the window applies to (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday).

block.description: The cluster's own maintenance window: when Skycloak applies upgrades and other disruptive changes. A singleton per cluster (create == update upsert). Destroying this resource does not leave the cluster without a window: it reverts the cluster to the workspace default window.

blacklisted_agents.description: User-agent regex patterns to always block.

whitelisted_agents.description: User-agent regex patterns to always allow.

enabled_realms.description: Realm IDs where challenges are presented during login.

captcha.description: Login-flow CAPTCHA challenges. Omit to leave the server's CAPTCHA settings unmanaged.

paths.description: Restrict the exclusion to these paths.

rule_ids.description: OWASP CRS rule IDs to disable.

block.description: Edge-security configuration for a cluster: IP allow-listing, rate limiting, WAF, geo-blocking, bot management, and CAPTCHA. A singleton per cluster. When the `captcha` block is omitted, the server's CAPTCHA settings are left untouched. CAPTCHA hostnames are registered via `skycloak_captcha_domain`.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded JAR. Recomputed each plan; a change publishes a new version.

jar.description: Path to the extension JAR file.

keycloak_version.description: Keycloak major version this JAR targets (e.g. `26`).

parameter_type.description: How parameters are supplied to the extension.

required.description: Whether the parameter must be supplied.

parameters.description: Configuration parameter schema exposed when installing the extension.

version.description: Semantic version (e.g. `1.0.0`). Bump it together with the JAR to publish a new version.

block.description: Uploads a custom Keycloak extension JAR to the workspace catalog. Changing the JAR contents or `version` publishes a new version; other metadata updates in place. Install it on a cluster with `skycloak_cluster_extension`.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded file. Recomputed each plan; a change recreates the theme.

file_size.description: Size of the uploaded archive in bytes.

source.description: Path to the theme archive (`.zip` or `.jar`).

theme_types.description: Subset of theme types to deploy (`login`, `account`, `admin`, `email`). Omit to deploy all detected types. Immutable.

block.description: Uploads a custom Keycloak theme (ZIP or Keycloakify JAR) to a cluster. Replacing the file contents or `theme_types` recreates the theme; `name`, `description`, and `version` update in place.

cname_target.description: CNAME target to point the domain at.

dns_records.description: DNS records to create for verification/routing.

block.description: A custom domain on a Skycloak cluster. After apply, create the returned `dns_records` at your DNS provider; verification then completes out of band (refresh to observe `verification_status`).

allow_admin_access.description: Allow admin console access through this route. Defaults to `false`.

cors_allowed_origins.description: CORS allowed origins for this route.

hide_realm_path.description: Serve the realm at the domain root (hide `/realms/<name>`). Set at creation; immutable.

block.description: Maps a realm onto a custom domain.

company_url.description: URL linked from the email footer.

footer_company_name.description: Company name shown in the email footer.

footer_text.description: Free-text shown in the email footer.

header_logo_dark_url.description: Logo URL for dark-background email clients.

header_logo_light_url.description: Logo URL for light-background email clients.

supported_locales.description: Locales available to users. Must include `default_locale`.

block.description: Email-template branding for a realm (a singleton; create == update upsert).

download_url.description: Time-limited presigned download URL. Expires; refresh to obtain a new one.

encryption_password.description: Password used to encrypt the archive (AES-256-CBC). Required when `include_credentials` is true. Write-only; never read back. Immutable.

expires_at.description: When the archive is deleted from storage (RFC 3339).

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the produced archive in bytes.

include_credentials.description: Include the Keycloak `credential` and related tables. Requires `encryption_password`. Immutable.

block.description: A one-shot database export job for a cluster. Creating the resource starts the export and waits for it to finish. The archive expires; recreate the resource to produce a fresh export.

client_secret.description: Upstream client secret. Write-only; never read back.

trust_email.description: Trust email addresses from this provider.

display_name.description: Display name shown on the login page.

enabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

externally_managed.description: True if the provider is managed outside Skycloak; such providers reject updates and deletes.

provider_id.description: Unique provider alias within the realm. Immutable.

block.description: An identity provider (SSO connection) in a Skycloak realm.

font_url.description: URL of a custom web font.

forgot_password_enabled.description: Defaults to the API's value when unset.

supported_locales.description: Locales available to users. Must include `default_locale`.

logo_url.description: URL of the logo displayed on the login page.

primary_color.description: Primary accent color applied to buttons (hex, e.g. `#0ea5e9`).

privacy_policy_url.description: URL of the privacy policy linked in the footer.

registration_enabled.description: Defaults to the API's value when unset.

remember_me_enabled.description: Defaults to the API's value when unset.

show_powered_by.description: Defaults to the API's value when unset.

enabled.description: Show identity provider buttons on the login page.

sso.description: Identity-provider button display on the login page.

terms_of_service_url.description: URL of the terms of service linked in the footer.

block.description: Login-page branding for a realm (a singleton; create == update upsert).

cluster_id.description: ID of the cluster the realm belongs to. Immutable.

duplicate_emails_allowed.description: Allow duplicate emails across users. Defaults to `false`.

enabled.description: Whether the realm is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

login_with_email_allowed.description: Allow login with email. Defaults to `false`.

name.description: Realm name (the Keycloak realm key). Immutable.

registration_email_as_username.description: Use email as username on registration. Defaults to `false`.

block.description: A Keycloak realm within a Skycloak cluster.

download_url.description: Time-limited presigned download URL. Null once the archive has expired.

encryption_password.description: Password used to encrypt the archive (AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2), 8-128 characters. Required: every realm export contains credentials. Write-only; never read back, so an imported resource plans a replacement until it is set. Immutable.

expires_at.description: When the archive is deleted from storage, 24h after completion (RFC 3339).

realm.description: Name of the realm to export. Immutable.

scope.description: Export scope. Only `full` is currently supported. Immutable.

sha256_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the encrypted archive (hex).

source_version.description: Keycloak version that produced the export. An import target must run this version or newer.

block.description: A one-shot export of a single realm (configuration, users, and credentials). Creating the resource starts the export and waits for it to finish. The archive is always encrypted and Skycloak deletes it 24 hours after completion, so `download_url` becomes null once `expires_at` has passed — recreate the resource to produce a fresh export.

name.description: Group name (leaf segment of the path).

parent_id.description: Parent group ID for a nested group. Immutable.

block.description: A realm group. Add users with `skycloak_realm_group_membership`.
Adds a user to a realm group. One resource per (user, group) edge.

password.description: Password that decrypts the artifact. Required for an encrypted archive (anything produced by `skycloak_realm_export`); omit only for a bare foreign realm JSON. Write-only; never read back. Immutable.

realm.description: Name of the imported realm, derived from the artifact.

source_export_id.description: ID of a stored `skycloak_realm_export` to import from. Required when `source_kind` is `stored`. Immutable.

source_file.description: Path to a local realm artifact to upload. Required when `source_kind` is `upload`. Immutable.

source_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `source_file`, tracked so a change to the file's bytes forces a new import even when the path is unchanged.

source_kind.description: Where the artifact comes from: `upload` (default, uses `source_file`) or `stored` (uses `source_export_id`). Immutable.

source_version.description: Keycloak version that produced the artifact.

target_version.description: Target cluster's Keycloak version at import time.

block.description: Imports a realm (configuration, users, and credentials) into a cluster. Creating the resource starts the import and waits for it to finish. The resource tracks the import *job*, not the resulting realm: destroying it removes the job from state and leaves the imported realm in place. Preflight validates the target Keycloak version, refuses a realm-name collision, and blocks on missing password-hash providers.

client_role.description: Whether this is a client-scoped role.

composite.description: Whether this role is composed from other roles.

name.description: Role name. Immutable (renaming recreates the role).

block.description: A realm-scoped role. Assign it to users with `skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment`.

email_verified.description: Whether the email address is verified. Defaults to `false`.

enabled.description: Whether the user can sign in. Defaults to `true`.

temporary_password.description: Initial password (min 8 chars). Write-only; changing it recreates the user (there is no password-update endpoint).

block.description: A realm user. Grant roles with `skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment` and group membership with `skycloak_realm_group_membership`.
Assigns a single realm role to a user. One resource per (user, role) edge.

max_events.description: Flush after this many events. Defaults to `1000`.

max_interval_seconds.description: Flush at least this often. Defaults to `60`.

batch.description: Batching tuning. Defaults to the API contract values (1000 events, 60 seconds) so an omitted block plans exactly what the server applies.

enabled.description: Whether forwarding is active. Defaults to `true`.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers. Values are write-only; reads return header names only.

has_access_key_secret.description: Whether a secret access key is stored.

cluster_ids.description: Cluster IDs to include. Omit for all clusters.

keycloak_event_types.description: Keycloak event type codes. Required when `type` is `keycloak_events`.

realms.description: Realm names to include. Omit for all realms.

source.description: Which workspace data stream is forwarded.

block.description: A SIEM forwarding destination for the workspace (syslog, S3, or HTTP). SIEM forwarding is plan-gated; the API rejects the calls on plans without it. Secret fields are write-only: the API never returns them, reads report `has_*` booleans instead, and Terraform keeps the configured values in state.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. Write-only; never read back. Omit to retain the stored value.

has_client_secret.description: Whether a client secret is stored.

password.description: SMTP password (when `auth_type` is `basic`). Write-only; never read back. Omit to retain the stored value.

block.description: SMTP configuration for a realm (a singleton; create == update upsert).

account.description: Custom theme ID to activate for the account console. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.

admin.description: Custom theme ID to activate for the admin console. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.

email.description: Custom theme ID to activate for the email templates. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.

login.description: Custom theme ID to activate for the login page. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.

block.description: Realm-level custom theme assignment per Keycloak theme type. A singleton per realm; managing this resource asserts the full assignment.

authorization_header.description: Authorization header value sent with each delivery. Write-only; omit to retain the stored value.

cluster_id.description: Scope deliveries to one cluster. Omit for all clusters.

enabled.description: Whether deliveries are active. Defaults to `true`.

event_types.description: Event types to deliver. See the `skycloak_webhook_event_types` data source for the catalog.

has_authorization_header.description: Whether an authorization header is stored.

has_signing_secret.description: Whether a signing secret is stored.

realm_id.description: Scope deliveries to one Keycloak realm ID (UUID).

signing_secret.description: HMAC secret used to sign deliveries, 32 to 512 characters. Write-only; never read back.

block.description: A webhook subscription delivering workspace events to an HTTPS endpoint. `signing_secret` and `authorization_header` are write-only: the API never returns them and reads report `has_*` booleans instead.

client_role.description: Whether the role is a client role.

block.description: Roles assigned to an application's service account.
Active user sessions for an application.

auto_upgrade_enabled.description: Whether automatic patch upgrades are enabled.

block.description: Look up an existing Skycloak cluster by ID.

client_id.description: Client ID of the cluster's automation service account.

client_secret.description: Client secret for the automation service account.

token_url.description: Token endpoint URL (master realm) for the client_credentials grant.

block.description: The cluster automation service account credentials for the OAuth2 client_credentials grant.
Recent Keycloak admin/user events for a cluster.
Exports a cluster's events as a document (the raw export body).

preview.description: Whether the feature is in preview.

block.description: Keycloak feature flags available to tenant clusters.

json.description: The analytics document as a JSON string.

block.description: Cluster analytics returned as a raw JSON document. Decode with `jsondecode()`.

available.description: Whether the region is available to this workspace.

block.description: Supported Skycloak deployment regions.
Recent application logs for a cluster.
Recent edge-security logs (WAF, geo-blocking, rate limiting) for a cluster.

available.description: Whether the workspace can provision this type.

block.description: Supported Skycloak cluster types.

required.description: Whether this version must be visited as an intermediate step.

block.description: Recommended version-upgrade path for a cluster, ordered from current to target.
Version-upgrade history for a cluster.

active.description: Whether the version is still offered for new clusters and upgrades. `false` means it is recognised, for example by a cluster already running it, but is no longer offered.

breaking_change_count.description: Number of breaking changes recorded for this version.

is_major_change.description: Whether moving onto this version from the previous supported version crosses a major version boundary.

version_details.description: The same versions in the same order, with the detail needed to judge an upgrade onto each.

block.description: Keycloak versions available for a cluster type.

allow_admin_access.description: Whether the admin console is reachable.

hide_realm_path.description: Whether the realm path is hidden.

block.description: Realm routes configured on a custom domain.
Extension catalog available to the workspace. Use an extension's `id` in `skycloak_cluster_extension`.
Pre-configured identity-provider templates. Use a template `id` as `template_id` when creating an identity provider.

issuer_url.description: OIDC issuer URL. The `/.well-known/openid-configuration` suffix is appended automatically.

block.description: Resolves an OIDC issuer's discovery document. Use the returned endpoints to pre-fill a `skycloak_identity_provider`.

enabled.description: Whether the user can sign in.

block.description: Users that belong to a realm group.
Top-level groups in a realm.
Realm-scoped roles in a realm.

enabled.description: Whether the user can sign in.

block.description: Users in a realm.
A single SIEM forwarding destination by ID.
All SIEM forwarding destinations in the workspace.

cluster_id.description: Cluster ID to list themes for.

deployed_at.description: Timestamp of the last successful deployment (RFC 3339).

file_size.description: Size of the uploaded archive in bytes.

theme_types.description: Keycloak theme types in the package (`login`, `account`, `admin`, `email`).

block.description: Custom themes uploaded to a cluster. Use a theme's `id` in `skycloak_theme_assignment` or `skycloak_client_theme_assignment`.
The catalog of event types webhook subscriptions can deliver.
All webhook subscriptions in the workspace.
